damage_story: The dam and reservoir survived, but an eastern powerhouse roof/bay failure and a separate crest-control collapse accompanied the deaths of the refugees sheltering in both abutments.
damage_zone: east powerhouse bay/roof and southeast crest-control corner
environment_layer: gravity-led powerhouse concrete and gravel debris
localized control-house roof rubble on the crest
intact reservoir, dam body, spillways and three primary turbine routes
preserved abutment tunnel entrances and emergency exits
occupation_layer: two zombie spawners distributed between the refuge intake zones
two irradiated spawners in the powerhouse
skeletal remains distributed across triage, bunks, stores and memorial routes
invariants: reservoir water and reinforced dam remain intact
three powerhouse bay routes and the surviving gallery remain accessible
the western half of crest control remains usable
both refuge programs, pressure thresholds, emergency exits and ladders survive
damage remains localized to the two declared failures
